critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error: TypeError 'unsupported operand type(s) for /: NoneType and int' at /app/backend/routes/bi_moe.py:197 — `u.get('rating', 0) / 5`. Some specialist users have rating=None (explicitly None, not missing) which bypasses dict.get default. Impact: BI-MOE 'Performance' tab (bi-tab-specialists) renders EmptyState 'Eroare la încărcare' — spec-top and spec-bottom DataTables never load. Fix: replace `u.get('rating', 0)` with `(u.get('rating') or 0)` (also for other numeric fields like completed_jobs, win_rate).

critical_code_review_comments: bi_moe.py L197 — numeric fields from DB can be None; use `(u.get('rating') or 0)` pattern consistently. Same defensive coalescing likely needed for win_rate and completed_jobs to prevent recurring 500s.

client_copilot.py L107 — cache read uses `generated_at: {$gte: cutoff}` string compare on ISO timestamps which relies on lexicographic ordering; works because ISO 8601 with Z suffix is lexicographically sortable — GOOD, but a `datetime` field would be more robust.
client_copilot.py L136-137 — LLM failure raises HTTPException(503) directly; frontend HomeV2 CopilotCard catches and shows 'Rezumatul AI e temporar indisponibil' fallback — GOOD.
ai_insights.py L118 — 'Trimite o campanie de re-verificare email' recommendation appears only when rate<70 AND total>0 — reasonable. Consider also gating on rate>0 to avoid weird message on empty DB.

AdminUsers.jsx L111 — useEffect deps miss `q` — search only triggers on submit (correct, avoids per-keystroke queries), but the current deps `[skip, role, emailVerifiedFilter, phoneVerifiedFilter, marketingFilter]` re-fetch when any filter changes yet ignore `q`. Since onSearch resets skip=0 + calls load(), the state read of q inside load() closure works only because load is redefined each render — OK.

BIMoePage.jsx L44-48 — Overview 'bi-ai-insights' passes only `bullets/alerts/recommendations` without `title` prop; if AIInsightCard requires a title, default is used — verify visually. Looked correct in screenshot.

rca of the issue: BI-MOE Performance 500 — RCA: In /app/backend/routes/bi_moe.py `specialist_performance()` L197, expression `u.get('rating', 0) / 5` fails when a user document has `rating: null` (dict.get default only applies to MISSING keys, not None values). Reproduce: any admin session, GET /api/admin/bi/specialist-performance?limit=10 → HTTP 500 with `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for /: 'NoneType' and 'int'` in stack trace `routes/bi_moe.py:197`. Fix: use `(u.get('rating') or 0)` — one-line change; also review win_rate and completed variables for same pattern. Post-fix retest: hit endpoint → 200 + BI-MOE Performance tab renders both DataTables.
